searchText: any objections to me merging https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/205 ? oh never mind, I can't 🙂 it's approved etc, and discussion has stopped, so its probably good to merge I think <@301186049323958275> are you still strongly opposed to keep "latest" and not introducing "unsafe"? Considering there is an explanation that "latest" is really unsafe and one should understand all subtleties before using it. I think if we aren't going to take the opportunity to point `latest` at something *other* than `unsafe` then most of my arguments fizzle. I really wanted to take the opportunity to make the whole ecosystem more resilient all at once, which is why I wanted `latest` to not alias to `unsafe`. We were discussing that we can't change the semantics of `latest` (other than deprecating it) after the Merge. I.e. if we're keeping `latest` it should always return the head; the only moment when we could change it is at the time of the Merge, but safe algorithm isn't there yet to make `latest` an alias to `safe`. Yeah, given that I'm willing to back down on my position and defer to others.
